subject: Factor Score Regression/SAM approach with higher-order model

messages.author: 88395b721382117a
messages.subject: Factor Score Regression/SAM approach with higher-order model
parts:
Hi,

I am running a study using latent variable analysis to do mediation model. The IV has a higher-order structure from CFA, and the mediator has a single factor structure. I am aware of Rosseel & Loh (2022)'s structural after measurement (SAM) approach, or factor score regression/path analysis by Kelcey (2019) & Devlieger et al. (2019). 

If I need to use this approach, could you suggest how to handle higher-order factor scores in FSR/SAM? I am currently struggling with Croon (2002)'s correction as the transformation from lavPredict does not apply to factor score generated from higher-order model. It would be really helpful to hear from you.

Thank you very much in advance!

Best regards,
Christine

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Factor Score Regression/SAM approach with higher-order model
parts:
On 12/15/23 02:21, Christine Kong-Yan Tong wrote:
> If I need to use this approach, could you suggest how to handle
> higher-order factor scores in FSR/SAM?

I am afraid this cannot be done yet. All theory about Croon/FSR/SAM is
(currently) only valid for single-order latent variables, where all
indicators are *observed* variables.

We do have plans in my research group to investigate the possibility of
having higher-order measurement models, but that will take some time
(perhaps years).

Yves.
